app.name: ISTQB-PREP
app.tagline: Prepare for the ISTQB Foundation Level exam

home.heroTitle: Prepare for the ISTQB Foundation Level exam
home.resumeTitle: You have a session in progress
home.intro: Every question is written from scratch against the syllabus learning objectives, every option has a rationale, and you can study Turkish and English side by side. No account, no fee, nothing leaves your device.
home.coverage: {{questions}} questions in the pool · {{covered}}/{{total}} learning objectives covered
home.poolWarningTitle: The pool cannot build a full exam yet
home.poolWarningBody: At most {{available}}/{{required}} questions can be assembled right now. The gaps are listed below.
home.studyBody: Read a learning objective, then test yourself on it.
home.practiceBody: Answer questions with no time limit; see the correct answer right after each one if you choose to.
home.examBody: Sit a timed, full-coverage mock exam, just like the real thing.

setup.title: Exam setup
setup.durationHint: Candidates sitting the exam in a non-native language get 25% extra time.
setup.contentLanguageHint: You can switch at any point during the exam; your answer is kept.

sources.title: Sources and copyright
sources.disclaimer: This platform is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with, nor endorsed by, ISTQB® or the Turkish Testing Board. The content is written from scratch against the official syllabus and does not reproduce exam questions. No guarantee is given regarding your exam result. For official and current information, see istqb.org and turkishtestingboard.org.
sources.privacyBody: No account, no server, no analytics. All your progress is stored only in your own browser's IndexedDB and is never sent anywhere. Clearing your browser data also clears your progress.
